tasks.title: Add --target to ops-verdict.sh
tasks.testCycle: bash tests/test-scripts.sh 2>&1 | grep -- '-- Case: --target keys the cap' ; expect the case to print PASS and the summary line '0 failed'

tasks.title: Strip the trailing CR run in ops-reverify.sh
tasks.testCycle: printf '| a | b | c | PASS |\r\r\n' > /tmp/l && bash scripts/ops-reverify.sh /tmp/l → prints 'a PASS' identical to the LF twin; exit 0

tasks.title: Improve the cap detector
tasks.testCycle: The detector works correctly and handles edge cases.

tasks.title: Refactor the statusline
tasks.testCycle: Run the tests.

tasks.title: BOM-proof the plan Status gate
tasks.testCycle: node tests/test_workflows.mjs → the 'spec Status gate: a leading BOM' assertion prints ok and the summary reports 0 failures

tasks.title: Guard the compressor hook without node
tasks.testCycle: PATH=/usr/bin:/bin bash -c "$(jq -r '.hooks.PostToolUse[0].hooks[0].command' hooks/hooks.json)" </dev/null; echo $? → prints 0

tasks.title: Make error handling robust
tasks.testCycle: Errors are handled gracefully and the user sees a helpful message.

tasks.title: Add MOOT verdict word
tasks.testCycle: ops-verdict.sh x crit ev MOOT --owner s writes a row ending '| MOOT |'; grep -c MOOT .operator/VERDICTS.md goes from 0 to 1

tasks.title: Speed up the shell suite
tasks.testCycle: The suite should be noticeably faster.

tasks.title: Pin JUDGMENT to the opus alias
tasks.testCycle: bash scripts/ops-tiers.sh --json | jq -r .JUDGMENT → opus

tasks.title: Validate model ids
tasks.testCycle: bash scripts/ops-tiers.sh --check

tasks.title: Document the landmines
tasks.testCycle: Output should be correct.

tasks.title: Refuse a symlinked sentinel
tasks.testCycle: ln -s /etc/passwd .operator/pending/x && ops-verdict.sh x c e PASS; expect exit 1, stderr contains 'non-regular', VERDICTS.md byte count unchanged

tasks.title: Add holdout canary
tasks.testCycle: Verify the canary behaves as expected by running it.

tasks.title: Floors for the node suite
tasks.testCycle: bash scripts/gate-suite.sh workflows exits 0 and prints 'workflows: 492 passed'; lowering FLOOR_WORKFLOWS above the count makes it exit 1

tasks.title: Clean up plan.js
tasks.testCycle: node tests/test_workflows.mjs passes and the code is cleaner and easier to read.

tasks.title: Session banner uses absolute paths
tasks.testCycle: echo '{"session_id":"s","cwd":"/tmp/p"}' | bash scripts/ops-sessionstart-hook.sh | jq -r .hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext | grep -c "'/tmp/p/.operator/bin/ops-task.sh'" → 1

tasks.title: Better debate synthesis
tasks.testCycle: The synthesis is higher quality and separates real disagreement.

tasks.title: Stop hook loop guard
tasks.testCycle: Run the stop hook twice with stop_hook_active=true and check it does the right thing.

tasks.title: Reject __ in task names
tasks.testCycle: bash scripts/ops-task.sh a__b --owner s; expect exit 2 and stderr 'must not contain __'; ls .operator/pending shows no new entry

tasks.title: Add a --suggest flag
tasks.testCycle: `ops-tiers.sh --suggest` should print suggestions.

tasks.title: Performance of caps cache
tasks.testCycle: time bash -c 'source scripts/lib/caps.sh; scan_caps_cached big.md' on a 4096-row ledger: second run under 50ms real, output identical to first

tasks.title: Normalize workflow args
tasks.testCycle: Passing a string topic works. Passing an object works too.

tasks.title: Release gate checks CHANGELOG
tasks.testCycle: python3 scripts/release_gate.py with plugin.json at 9.9.9 and no '## [9.9.9]' heading → exit 1, stderr names 9.9.9
